input.command:
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
mkdir -p tmpinc/sub && printf 'a=1
@include b.conf
' > tmpinc/a.conf && printf '@include a.conf
' > tmpinc/b.conf && printf '@include nope.conf
' > tmpinc/m.conf && printf 'x=1
@include sub/c.conf
x=3
' > tmpinc/n.conf && printf 'x=2
y=2
@include d.conf
' > tmpinc/sub/c.conf && printf 'z=9
' > tmpinc/sub/d.conf
python - <<'EOF'
from miniconf.loader import load
print(vars(load('examples/service.conf')))
for f in ('a','m'):
    try: load('tmpinc/%s.conf'%f)
    except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
print(vars(load('tmpinc/n.conf')))
EOF
rm -rf tmpinc
